sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Cleric:
Increases HP recovery effects of a healing Ability by XL.
Reduces Cooldown for the Ability used by 20%.
Target: yourself. Recovers 5 Cost.
Ability Power scales with the number of Book/Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 4XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 6).

[Activation]
When a healing Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Cleric.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Book/Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XXL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
